|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Hoth: Snow Trench (2nd Marker) (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Hoth: Snow Trench (2nd Marker) (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 2 October 2023<ref name="ht-88182de">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual22-Light/large/hothsnowtrench.gif</code> as published 2 October 2023: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/88182de5459f1ffeeb3856f4ece24e2f4c6a7437/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Light/large/hothsnowtrench.gif holotable commit 88182de] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “'''Light Side:''' Your artillery weapons deploy -2 here. Once per game, may deploy an artillery weapon here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. '''Dark Side:''' Your deploy costs may not be modified here.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Hoth: Snow Trench (2nd Marker) (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 22 release sheet<ref name="sheet22-20231006">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2023”; file created 6 October 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 22]] (2 October 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 5, file created 6 October 2023: “'''Light Side:''' Your artillery weapons deploy -2 here. Once per game, may deploy an artillery weapon here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. '''Dark Side:''' Your deploy costs may not be modified here.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Hoth: Snow Trench (2nd Marker) (V)]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Hoth: Snow Trench (2nd Marker) (V)]] (published 2 October 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Hoth: Snow Trench”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Hoth: Snow Trench (2nd Marker)]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
